title: Authorize loading-list and preloading shipment tracking reads with live menu and customer scope
description: Stage3 loading/shipping operational-link closure. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ContainerPreLoadingController.cs:162-168 and src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ContainerLoadingListController.cs:275-281 expose GET {id}/shipment-tracking with no live identity, menu or customer scope, while every sibling route (including the adjacent shipment-timeline route at ContainerPreLoadingController.cs:181-183 and ContainerLoadingListController.cs:294-296) authorizes; docs/loading-list-authorization.md:121 records these routes as deliberately deferred. Reuse the existing PreLoadingAuthorizationRules and LoadingListAuthorizationRules exactly, add no grants, no anonymous/admin fallback, no schema or production change, and change no tracking DTO semantics. Use genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: Before returning shipment tracking, require the current enabled nondeleted authenticated account, the existing preloading and loading-list functional menus and the authoritative customer scope by reusing PreLoadingAuthorizationRules and LoadingListAuthorizationRules exactly on GET /api/container/pre-loadings/{id}/shipment-tracking and GET /api/container/loading-lists/{id}/shipment-tracking; no new grants, no anonymous or admin fallback and no request-path or export-menu exemption.

Resolve the persisted preloading or loading-list and its booking reference only after scope passes so foreign, deleted or missing documents return the same controlled non-disclosing not-found error as the sibling shipment-timeline routes, without leaking container numbers, booking ids, ETD/ETA or customs-broker values, and preserve the existing ContainerShipmentTrackingDto, null-as-unknown semantics and read-only behavior.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover own, foreign and deleted documents, mixed-participant shared shipments and explicit upstream customers, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities, missing functional menu and permitted privileged access on both routes, and assert denial leaves preloading, loading-list, booking, shipment-reference and milestone rows unchanged while ERP-040/057/059 tracking and timeline contracts still hold.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ContainerPreLoadingController.cs:162-168 GetShipmentTracking calls GetOrThrowAsync then ContainerShipmentTrackingService.ResolveForPreLoadingAsync with no PreLoadingAuthorizationRules.EnsureAuthorizedAsync/EnsureStoredScopeAllowedAsync, unlike the guarded shipment-timeline route at lines 175-188 and every other route in the file. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ContainerLoadingListController.cs:275-281 GetShipmentTracking is likewise unguarded while the adjacent shipment-timeline route (288-301) and all other routes authorize. docs/loading-list-authorization.md:119-122 records these exact routes as deferred ('单证带入 / 生成与出运跟踪路由暂未接入本护栏'). No task in .ai/tasks lists these two routes or these controllers for the tracking route.
